Name: Minesweeper
Description: The classic minefield puzzle, clearing a grid by reading the numbers and never uncovering a mine.

Achievements.Name: Use what now?
Achievements.Description: Completed a minefield without using any flags on a minefield that is 9x9 or larger.

Achievements.Name: Click click BOOM!
Achievements.Description: Trigger a mine on the second click.

Achievements.Name: High Five!
Achievements.Description: Win a speed mode game with more than 10 seconds left on the clock.

Achievements.Name: Piece of cake!
Achievements.Description: Complete a minefield with five digs or less.

Achievements.Name: Serious Business
Achievements.Description: Reveal a square with a 6 or higher.

Achievements.Name: The world is safe... for now
Achievements.Description: Win a game on each difficulty in both Classic and Speed modes.

Achievements.Name: I don't need those
Achievements.Description: Win a game without using any powerups ranked as Player or higher.

Achievements.Name: Training wheels
Achievements.Description: Win a game on a minefield that is at least 12x12.
